list.name: patient
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT patient_id FROM cgm_features ORDER BY 1

list.name: horizon
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT horizon_min FROM model_predictions ORDER BY 1

panels.title: TFT vs Persistence RMSE -- Patient $patient (T+$horizon min)
panels.description: Rolling RMSE comparison. TFT should beat persistence baseline. Persistence = last known value carried forward.

targets.rawSql: SELECT time_bucket('1 hour', time) AS "time", model AS metric, rmse AS value FROM (SELECT time, 'tft' AS model, rmse FROM model_metrics WHERE patient_id = '$patient' AND horizon_min = $horizon UNION ALL SELECT time, 'persistence' AS model, rmse FROM persistence_metrics WHERE patient_id = '$patient' AND horizon_min = $horizon) sub WHERE $__timeFilter(time) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1;

panels.title: Prediction vs Actual -- Patient $patient (T+$horizon min)
panels.description: Overlay of TFT predictions, persistence baseline, and actual glucose values.

targets.rawSql: SELECT time AS "time", actual_glucose AS glucose FROM model_predictions WHERE patient_id = '$patient' AND horizon_min = $horizon AND $__timeFilter(time) ORDER BY time;
SELECT time AS "time", tft_prediction AS tft FROM model_predictions WHERE patient_id = '$patient' AND horizon_min = $horizon AND $__timeFilter(time) ORDER BY time;
SELECT time AS "time", persistence_prediction AS persistence FROM model_predictions WHERE patient_id = '$patient' AND horizon_min = $horizon AND $__timeFilter(time) ORDER BY time;

panels.title: Clarke Error Grid Zone Distribution -- All Test Patients (T+$horizon min)
panels.description: Clinical accuracy zones: A = accurate, B = benign, C = overcorrection, D = failure to detect, E = dangerous. TFT should have >70% in Zone A.

targets.rawSql: SELECT zone AS category, count AS value FROM clarke_zones WHERE horizon_min = $horizon ORDER BY CASE zone WHEN 'A' THEN 1 WHEN 'B' THEN 2 WHEN 'C' THEN 3 WHEN 'D' THEN 4 WHEN 'E' THEN 5 END;

panels.title: 80% Prediction Interval Coverage -- Patient $patient (T+$horizon min)
panels.description: Fraction of actual values falling within the model's 80% prediction interval. Target ~80%. Below 70% indicates miscalibration.

targets.rawSql: SELECT time_bucket('1 hour', time) AS "time", 100.0 * AVG(CASE WHEN actual_glucose BETWEEN pi_lower AND pi_upper THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS coverage_pct FROM model_predictions WHERE patient_id = '$patient' AND horizon_min = $horizon AND $__timeFilter(time) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

panels.title: Overall TFT vs Persistence -- T+$horizon min (Test Patients)
panels.description: Aggregate RMSE across all test patients. Green = TFT beats persistence.

targets.rawSql: SELECT 'TFT' AS model, AVG(rmse) AS rmse FROM model_metrics WHERE horizon_min = $horizon AND patient_id IN (SELECT patient_id FROM patient_splits WHERE split = 'test') UNION ALL SELECT 'Persistence', AVG(rmse) FROM persistence_metrics WHERE horizon_min = $horizon AND patient_id IN (SELECT patient_id FROM patient_splits WHERE split = 'test');

panels.title: Per-Patient RMSE -- T+$horizon min
panels.description: Individual patient performance on test set. Small N = high variance expected.

targets.rawSql: SELECT patient_id, tft_rmse, persistence_rmse, tft_rmse - persistence_rmse AS delta, CASE WHEN tft_rmse < persistence_rmse THEN 'TFT wins' ELSE 'Persistence wins' END AS winner FROM (SELECT m.patient_id, AVG(m.rmse) AS tft_rmse, AVG(p.rmse) AS persistence_rmse FROM model_metrics m JOIN persistence_metrics p ON m.patient_id = p.patient_id AND m.horizon_min = p.horizon_min WHERE m.horizon_min = $horizon AND m.patient_id IN (SELECT patient_id FROM patient_splits WHERE split = 'test') GROUP BY m.patient_id) sub ORDER BY delta;
